notes.title: Letter Factories are here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42884193/ca02e022382f4d5e9cc22ceb6e7f418c43d0dd5d.gif[/img]

In this content update, we've added a new optional feature: [b]Letter Factories[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42884193/d2247925441894c7d084267b9469cf759866c99b.png[/img]

[h2]What are Letter Factories?[/h2]

Letter Factories allow you to select a group of buildings, and save them as a custom factory, which you can then place in any level.

For example, if you place all the buildings to make an A, and multi-select them...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42884193/44b7e71d3e94117227de79ae853f5ad7f0422fea.png[/img]

You can save that building configuration as a new A factory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42884193/d2247925441894c7d084267b9469cf759866c99b.png[/img]

Letter Factories retain their building count and cycles, so they're typically not the best option for optimizing levels. But they make it quick and easy to build recipes you've already learned.

[h2]How to access the Letter Factory feature[/h2]

Since they can have a significant impact on the play experience, we recommend leaving Letter Factories disabled until you've completed 3 pages of levels (you will be prompted once we suggest you enable them).

To enable Letter Factories, navigate to the Options menu and click "Letter Factories". Once enabled, you will be taken to a tutorial level that teaches you how they work.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42884193/314d7bc00e3e2e98ce320ff284227038c42430d4.png[/img]

[h2]Do you have feedback?[/h2]

If you have feedback on Letter Factories (or anything else), we'd love to hear it! The best way to get in touch is to [url=https://discord.gg/qCZyTrZacJ]join our Discord[/url], or [url=https://stargardengames.com/contact]email us[/url].

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Big changes to the letter recipe system!
notes.content:
The latest update includes a bit of an overhaul to the letter recipe system and the recipe journal. We have added many new recipes to the game, and removed a couple of the least intuitive ones. However, you don't have to discover them all to complete your recipe book. 

If you've already earned the achievement for completing your recipe book, don't worry - that won't go away!

[h2]Here's how it works[/h2]

Each letter has some "standard recipes", which look like this in the recipe book when you have not yet discovered them:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42884193/807320586286d6a6489fb35ba211eeb2ac254e52.png[/img]

Once you discover a standard recipe, it looks like this in the book:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42884193/b59620e4fc2c442988298b0305cddcc71610819d.png[/img]

In order to "complete your recipe book", you need to discover all of the standard recipes. The recipe count at the top of the journal shows your progress (this number may change as we make more updates):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42884193/d436b2dd722df1aff77e41559500686468114827.png[/img]

But what is that + 4?? That shows that this player has discovered 4 hidden recipes. You may have found some secret characters already, but now we have expanded this system to include regular letters with some of the more unusual recipes. For example, if you discover a hidden recipe for A, it will appear like this in the recipe book (recipe redacted):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42884193/7401cc53d92dd64a6a35c9bf095feaa220f57ae0.png[/img]

This way, you will be rewarded for experimenting and trying out-of-the-box ideas to form letters, but it is purely a bonus, and not a requirement to complete the book.

[h2]Do you have feedback for recipes?[/h2]

Thank you to everyone who submitted recipe feedback! If you have more ideas, please continue to send them with [url=https://forms.gle/3yeocrJ2aytaxkEy8]this form[/url].

notes.title: The Word Factori Demo is coming THIS MONTH! And other updates
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42884193/9387752bd6ccf53719c05fe992f0d0fba3e32dfd.png[/img]

[h2]Here's your monthly update from Star Garden Games, developers of Word Factori & Sixit. [/h2]

Hi there! We're going to try these monthly developer updates to keep you in the loop. Let us know if you find it interesting. 🙂 

In this month's post:

[list]
[*] News: about the Word Factori demo & the completed Beta test
[*] New feature: multi select buildings to move and delete them!
[*] New feature: physics!
[/list] 
­
­[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42884193/922299331df93f48909382ca73097f2b355a4ff6.gif[/img]

[h2]The Word Factori demo is coming this month[/h2]
Exciting news: the Word Factori demo will be publicly playable on Steam THIS MONTH (March)!

We ran a Beta test in February, and the feedback we received was extremely helpful. Thank you to everyone who participated. We've already made several changes to the upcoming demo based on your surveys. 

Keep an eye out for news on the launch of the demo. We will post on our [url=https://twitter.com/stargardengames]Twitter[/url] & [url=https://discord.gg/qCZyTrZacJ]Discord[/url], and [url=https://stargardengames.com/newsletter]email newsletter[/url] to let you know. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42884193/ffa27c7d32a79cf35755d56e3b8ec45cba011037.gif[/img]

[h2]New feature: Multi Select![/h2]
Based on feedback from you all, we've added a multi select feature to Word Factori. Now, you can click and drag to select multiple buildings. Then, you can move them all at once, or delete them all with one click. So convenient!

­[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42884193/4ea93c9469275f955493fd6118b51cfd01e97944.gif[/img]

[h2]New feature: Physics & juggling![/h2]
When you complete a level in Word Factori, you produce boxes that shoot into the right side of the screen. Well, now those boxes have physics. And you can click on the boxes to juggle them. Why did we add this feature? You'll see when you start playing with it.

­
[h2]Thanks for reading![/h2]
By the way, have you wishlisted Word Factori on Steam yet?? Do it now!


­https://store.steampowered.com/app/2072840/Word_Factori/

notes.title: Word Factori is Coming to Steam! What's new?
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2072840/extras/steam-gif-factori-dark-opt.gif?t=1661858277[/img]

Word Factori (previously known as factori) was originally made in 48 hours for the 2021 GMTK Game Jam. It was voted #1 by players and selected as a top game by Mark Brown. Since then, we released a 1.0 version on Itch. Now, we’re finally ready to announce that the game is coming to Steam with new features and improvements!

[h2]So what’s new?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Hard mode: challenge levels where there are restrictions on what buildings you can use
[*] Dark mode
[*] Quality of life improvements and polish
[*] More secrets
[*] Steam achievements
[*] Cloud saving
[*] More to be announced in the future!
[/list]

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/qCZyTrZacJ]Discord[/url] to get notified with the demo is live!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2072840/extras/building-silhouettes-banner-translucent.png?t=1661858277[/img]
